digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure: subprocess and network reliability sentinels
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted consumes 15+ seconds using production-scale 10s low-speed window with 15s loopback server despite contract requiring only throughput above floor across one window

test_read_retried_then_terminal consumes ~9 seconds using 1s call timeout plus real production 2s/4s backoff sleeps across three processes despite contract requiring only exact retry schedule and process cleanup

Injecting short test-only windows (1s stall, 0.1s call/grace/drain) with real socket/process execution and polling-based cleanup will reduce test suite wall time while preserving production defaults and semantic contracts
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff configuration values must remain unchanged in all code paths
